manifest.name: gdn-fp8-state-blockfit
manifest.description: FP8 on the recurrent state projections qkv and z in layers 1-63 (the map of gdn-state-fp8-skip0, #11), with every projection that stays NVFP4 re-encoded by nvfp4_blockfit: all MLP and attention layers, every recurrent out projection and the whole of recurrent layer 0. The two changes fix different errors. FP8 on qkv and z keeps the recurrent state and retrieval close to BF16, and nvfp4_blockfit picks each NVFP4 block scale by reconstruction error instead of round-to-nearest, which cuts the weight error of the NVFP4 layers to about 0.73x with the same format and kernels. lm_head is stored BF16, so its batch-1 Q4_K is fitted once from the original weights. Layer 0 and attention layer 3 stay NVFP4, so the fast prefill paths stay on. Speed and memory should match #11; drift should fall in every section, because the gain is a better weight fit, not a fit to any text.
